test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
'A # B' means 'A is brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If W % D # G @ B & M @ I, then how is D related to M?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 &
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: W % D # G @ B & M @ I

It means: W is the Wife of D, D is the Brother of G, G is the Daughter of B, B is the Husband of M, M is the Daughter of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e39deacfd2b78bb9b6b4fb685ed0de2ab8de703b352aacf58585502df2c7fea2.png] 

So, D is the 'Son' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
